_note: The largest value representable in decimal(38,9): 29 integral digits, 9 fractional. Must round-trip EXACTLY. Any float in the path loses it, which is why RFC 0003 bans floats from the IR and every emission path.
The negated twin of decimal38_9_max.
One integral digit past decimal38_9_max. `coercible` fires.
One unit in the last place at scale 9 - the smallest non-zero value the type holds.
Half a ulp. DuckDB rounds it UP to 1E-9; other engines truncate to 0. Decimal rounding is a named dialect divergence (s6) and this is its specimen.
Signed zero at full scale. Coerces to zero; the sign must not survive into the stored value or a canonical-bytes hash.
No float representation exists anywhere in the IR (RFC 0003), so NaN can only be quarantined - never coerced to zero, which would silently move a total.
As nan, positive direction.
As nan, negative direction.
Largest signed 64-bit integer.
Smallest signed 64-bit integer - asymmetric with int64_max by one, which is the row that catches an abs() inside a `range` rule.
One past int64_max. Fits decimal(38,9) but not BIGINT, so the disposition depends on the DECLARED field type - the specimen for that difference.
Bare zero where a timestamp is expected. It reads as epoch 1970-01-01 only under a declared transform; as a timestamp string it does not cast.
The instant epoch_zero probably means, in a form that casts.
The SCD2 end-of-time sentinel (RFC 0010). Must survive - a quarantined sentinel closes every open record.
The other end of the range. Proleptic Gregorian; engines disagree about it, so this is a dialect-matrix row as much as a boundary row.

BOTH sides of the distinction in ONE row: raw_value is a QUOTED empty (the empty STRING, non-null) and raw_kind is an UNQUOTED empty (SQL NULL). A reader that collapses them makes this row indistinguishable from zero_length_row. Read with allow_quoted_nulls=false; the DuckDB default collapses both to NULL.
Exactly 10000 characters - the 25-letter run a..y repeated 400 times. Trips any `length` rule and any VARCHAR(n) target; deterministic and diff-legible.

EVERY payload field absent. A genuinely empty LINE is not a row at all - csv.DictReader skips it and DuckDB skips it - so the specimen is a well-formed row whose every payload value is NULL. Ingestion metadata is intact so the row stays attributable; the deliberate metadata violations live in keys.csv.
The lower bound against long_string_10k: one character, non-empty, non-null.
